name: Evelina Lynzel
original_name: エヴェリーナ・リンゼル
source:
[i]“Repent that you continue to live today. Atone for the sin of living until tomorrow.”[/i]

[i]Puppeteer of Fragile Hearts[/i]

The second wife of Marquess Lynzel and the king's younger sister. Her golden locks and a visage that brings to mind a flower in full bloom strike all those that see her speechless. She radiates an indescribable aura, but underneath the beautiful exterior is a black heart. She is a cruel and merciless sadist.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=evelina]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
